item: Fix dates, budget cap and the goal line
Book stays (refundable where possible)
Book safari, rafting or tent slots
Book darshan or entry slots online if needed
Check weather for each place
Check Road watch and fresh road news for the route
Confirm stays have a veg kitchen or veg restaurant nearby
Car service: brakes, tyres, wipers, AC
Check car insurance, PUC and FASTag balance
Tyre pressure and spare tyre, jack, tool kit
Fuel tank full
Download offline Google Maps for the region
Medicine kit: fever, motion sickness, ORS, band-aids, personal medicines
Snacks and water for the drive (veg: thepla, chikki, fruit)
Cash for tolls, villages and homestays
Licence, RC, ID for everyone, booking confirmations
Board games, cards, chargers, power bank
Weather clothes: rain gear or warm layer
Log spending every evening
Break every 2 hours; no driving after dark
Review: happiness score, spend vs budget, repeat or skip
